Private Function Joined(ByVal values As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    For i = LBound(values) To UBound(values): s = s & "/" & TypeName(values(i)) & ":" & values(i): Next
    Joined = "[" & LBound(values) & "]" & s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Joined = "E" & Err.Number & s
End Function
